svg.title: aws-tui Glue, Athena, Iceberg, and S3 architecture
svg.desc: Five enforced application layers connect Textual service pages to VMx viewmodels, service plugins, typed domain adapters, and infrastructure. Immutable table and S3 messages preserve exact connection and region identity across Glue, Athena, Iceberg metadata, and S3 workflows.

g.text: generated SQL → editor review → explicit Ctrl+Enter; never auto-run
opaque component mask; arrows remain behind boxes
All table handoffs preserve catalog, database, table, connection name, and region. Iceberg metadata and generated table SQL are read-only.
Every diagram element maps to src/aws_tui; no service imports another service's Textual view.
